summary: The root "wsq" relates to driving animals. A "waseeqah" is a herd of cattle being driven, similar to "sayyiqah" and "mi'taq".
lane: وَسِيقَةٌ ذ A mob of driven cattle: see سَيِّقَهٌ and مِعْتَاقٌ .

headwords.def: وَسْقٌ A camel's load: see وِقْرٌ.
وَسِيقَةٌ A mob of driven cattle: see سَيِّقَهٌ and مِعْتَاقٌ.

headword_note: Lane indexes geminate roots with two letters where the Corpus uses three; both spellings are resolved here.
